svg.text: ℤ/(2^a·3^b) ≅ ℤ/2^a × ℤ/3^b — one coprime walk fills the whole grid; the stagger is the 2-adic/3-adic beat
ladder of CRT lattices — beat period 2^a·3^b grows left → right (all genuine, bijection verified)
interference · rotate · cohere ⇄ decohere (a=4, b=3 · 432-cell walk)
n ↦ (n mod 2^a, n mod 3^b); step n→n+1 moves +1 right and +1 up.
gcd(2^a,3^b)=1, so one walk visits every cell of the 2^a×3^b grid exactly once.
the walk closes after lcm(2^a,3^b) = 2^a·3^b steps (=432 for a=4,b=3).
diagonal segments are the beat between the period-2^a and period-3^b gratings.
two copies counter-rotate (periods 41 s vs 53 s) — the moiré sweeps.
their opacity oscillates out of phase (period 19 s): the overlay reinforces then washes out.
coprimality and the 432-cell bijection are machine-checked; the towers 2^46·3^20 divide |Monster|.
